name: Devana
subtitle: Woodland Huntress
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Goddess of the wilds, the hunt, and the moon, Devana is a figure of both veneration and fear, protection and terror. Her skills would prove a powerful advantage for Vyraj’s pantheon, but she has ignored Perun’s efforts at unification, focused instead on proving her superiority over other realms’ hunter deities—especially Artemis, whom Devana despises as a pretender to her own renown.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [debuff] on an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Weapon Multiplier +15%, Armor Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Huntress Omen
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 35% chance to decrease the turn meter of each target by 20%.

skills.name: Verdant Silence
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:lock-core] on the target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Has a 75% chance to place [Sleep] on all other enemies for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lingering Omen
skills.description: When an enemy receives a Turn Meter increase, this hero [Retaliates].
skills.awakening_bonus: Also [Retaliates] when an enemy decreases this hero’s Turn Meter.

skills.name: Storm of Arrows
skills.description: Attack all enemies 2 times with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] and [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns.

imprint_passive: When an enemy increases a turn meter, this hero has a 50% chance to counter-attack with their basic ability.
